intended_use.value: Internal use by Acme team members to process their own meeting notes or shared team meeting notes.

limitations.value: Cannot access meeting recordings, calendar systems, or external document storage. Cannot verify accuracy of the notes provided or cross-reference with other meetings. Effectiveness depends on the quality and completeness of the input notes.

out_of_scope_uses.value: Not for legal record-keeping, compliance documentation, or processing confidential HR/legal matters requiring specialized handling. Cannot schedule tasks, assign work in project management tools, or send notifications.

purpose.value: Helps Acme employees quickly extract decisions and action items from meeting notes.
